acceptedAnswer.text: Price depends on size, depth and site conditions. We provide an exact quote after a free site visit.

mainEntity.name: How often should a pond be cleaned?

acceptedAnswer.text: Typically every 2–3 years, or when the water starts to turn green and cloudy. Frequency depends on pond size and load.

mainEntity.name: Will the pond freeze over in winter?

acceptedAnswer.text: A sufficiently deep pond (from 1.5 m) does not freeze to the bottom. Fish need at least 1.5 m depth to overwinter. We advise on your specific case.

mainEntity.name: What fish suit a garden pond?

acceptedAnswer.text: Crucian carp, common carp, chub — good for beginners, tolerant of temperature fluctuations. We advise based on pond size and owner preferences.
Vilnius and Vilnius district. For larger projects — all of Lithuania.
